Problem Statement:
Salesman A has to reach a destination B as soon as possible to deliver a product. The roads of the city are modelled as a matrix, with every cell in the matrix denoting the distance a road covers. Find out the shortest distance that the salesman can travel so as to reach the destination soon.
input_spec: Dimensions of the matrix followed by the elements of the matrix. Elements A and B represent positions of the salesman and the destination respectively.
